results.label: this tree ships the M112 trading-window rule (the committed parent does not, and that absence is this probe's control)
the dialog exists as a labelled action per account, addressed by that account’s own id
the pane states the window in the trader’s own terms and names who chose it, when there is none and when there is
the bots view carries the window line beside the killzone restriction rather than only inside a veto string
the accounts pane renders the window action for the trader’s own desk
the dialog names the zone the app will hold the boundary on, and it is the account’s own routine zone
the two sides are time inputs with their own ids, so a trader types a clock and not a number of minutes
both are EMPTY on a desk with no window: the dialog never pre-fills a boundary the trader did not choose
the rule that makes the boundary unambiguous is written next to the fields: half-open, and a start after the end runs through midnight
the module’s own sentence for the current state is shown rather than a paraphrase
with nothing to derive the dialog SAYS so instead of hiding the block or showing an empty button
a start without an end is refused in the dialog, with the reason, and NOTHING is written
two equal times are refused too — the dialog will not read them as “all day”
saving sends exactly the two sides to the window endpoint, with the account they belong to
and it never sends a zone of its own: the zone is the account’s own setting, not something the dialog decides
the save is reported and the dialog closes only after the server answered
the server stored that pair for this desk, so the dialog and the guardrail read the same boundary
the pane now states the saved window with its source, so a reload does not lose who chose it
reopening shows the STORED pair, not empty fields and not a suggestion
clearing sends BOTH sides as null rather than an empty pair or a silent omission
and the toast says what clearing means, because “nothing blocked” is the whole point of the choice
the cleared desk is back to unset on the server too
with 34 recorded London closes the dialog offers the band it derived, in the trader’s own clock, as a BUTTON
the offer explains WHOSE journal it came from and how many trades cleared the floor, on the same screen
and it says what the suggestion is NOT, before the trader clicks it
opening the dialog applied nothing: looking at the suggestion writes no window at all
clicking it sends `accept_suggestion` rather than a pair the client computed itself
and the server recorded it as accepted from the journal, not as something the trader typed
the toast names that difference too, so the trader knows what they just accepted
no uncaught error was raised by any interaction

scope: M112 real DOM: the dialog the trader owns the window with: actual runtime/auth/SQL/HTTP with a frozen UTC clock, a synthetic calendar fed through the app's own parser and a patched market module for the thrown-read path; M111 calendar-read states (blocked/clear/unknown), no provider/broker/pixel/human proof and no claim about what a release does to price
